Description: Checks that per-client rate limiting is enforced.
Risk: Without per-client limits, one client can consume shared org rate limit capacity and degrade availability.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Settings > Account.
2. Open Client-based rate limiting and click Edit.
3. Select Enforce and log per client.
4. Review client capacity allocations and avoid assigning full-org capacity to any single client.
5. Save and monitor System Log events for client rate-limit activity.

Recommendation.Text: Enable per-client rate limiting and keep client capacity below full-org capacity so one client cannot consume all login or authorize capacity.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
